material.title: Studio Acme ships Skyward across PC and consoles today
material.bodyOriginal: Acme today released Skyward on Steam, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The launch build includes co-op and a season roadmap. A day-one patch (1.2GB) fixes progression blockers.
